title: Deep Intel Feed Matrix
boundary: This feed matrix ranks public-record source lanes and site signals. It does not make private claims, does not treat association as proof, and does not convert speculation into fact.

lanes.title: Daily public-source drops
lanes.summary: Current dated source drops used by Live Intel, clocks, cards, user briefs and Matrix Brain.
lanes.intakeRule: Start with data/latest-public-drops.json and preserve source, date, evidence class, boundary, route and next action.

lanes.title: EU AI Act implementation and cyber-AI governance
lanes.summary: Current lane for AI Act dates, GPAI rules, transparency duties, high-risk systems, AI Office guidance and AI/cyber governance.
lanes.intakeRule: Prefer European Commission AI Act pages, AI Office materials, legal text, national authority pages and enforcement actions.

lanes.title: Digital ID and EUDI Wallet implementation
lanes.summary: Current lane for EUDI Wallet rollout, relying-party rules, credential disclosure, biometric identity and identity wallet integration.
lanes.intakeRule: Prefer EU regulation/implementing acts, national wallet pages, relying-party registries, technical standards and privacy/security audits.

lanes.title: CBDC, digital euro and programmable payment rails
lanes.summary: Current lane for ECB digital euro readiness, EU legislation, pilots, wallet design, private payment dependence and tokenised settlement.
lanes.intakeRule: Prefer ECB pages, ECB progress reports, Parliament/Council records, central-bank documents, pilot data and implementation rules.

lanes.title: WHO Pandemic Agreement, PABS and health-governance records
lanes.summary: Current lane for WHO Pandemic Agreement adoption, PABS annex negotiation, ratification, national implementation and health-governance infrastructure.
lanes.intakeRule: Prefer WHO agreement pages, WHA decisions, IGWG documents, annex drafts, national ratification records and parliamentary materials.

lanes.title: Risk clocks and policy-convergence routes
lanes.summary: Clock pressure scores, linked drops, evidence boundaries and homepage eligibility checks.
lanes.intakeRule: Update scores only from dated source-linked signals; keep score movement separated from prediction claims.

lanes.title: Card intelligence feed and source ledger
lanes.summary: Scores, rationale, update triggers, relationship-note slots and source-backed entries for all card decks.
lanes.intakeRule: Use data/card-intelligence-feed.json and data/card-source-ledger.json. No source link, no ledger entry.

lanes.title: Courts, filings, dockets and public records
lanes.summary: Highest-value lane for verified claims, legal process, public filings, judgments, exhibits, settlements and enforcement records.
lanes.intakeRule: Prefer primary dockets, filings, judgments, official releases and exhibits before commentary.

lanes.title: SEC filings, ownership and asset managers
lanes.summary: BlackRock, Vanguard, State Street, ownership, proxy voting, 13F, mandates and market-structure routes.
lanes.intakeRule: Use SEC filings, proxy statements, stewardship reports, official company disclosures and market-structure records.

lanes.title: Government contracts and procurement records
lanes.summary: Awards, vendor relationships, contractor outsourcing, public money and state/private implementation routes.
lanes.intakeRule: Prefer award notices, procurement portals, contract records, budget documents and official vendor disclosures.

lanes.title: Missing records and evidence gaps
lanes.summary: Highest-value source gaps requiring primary record confirmation before any claim upgrade.
lanes.intakeRule: Every missing-record item must identify the exact primary record, docket, PDF, filing, award notice, registry, or archive needed.

items.title: Digital ID: EUDI Wallet late-2026 rollout watch
WHO Pandemic Agreement: PABS annex negotiation watch
EU AI Act: August 2026 transparency rules and 2027/2028 high-risk timetable

Card source ledger: no source link, no ledger entry
Missing record queue: remove placeholder [object Object] entries and require exact primary record targets

dailyRefreshContract.rule: Daily updates must refresh latest-public-drops, global-risk-clocks, deep-intel-feed-matrix, daily-power-conclusions, card-intelligence-feed, card-source-ledger, user briefs, homepage deck links and site-health reports.
qualityGate: No stale activeWindow item without archive route.
No [object Object] strings in public files.
No repeated Latest public drops text inside clock signals.
Every score movement must include a dated source route.
Every card ledger entry must have a source link and review status.
Every user brief must include conclusion, why it matters, evidence boundary and next action.
